Added: `.github/workflows/mirror-tags.yml` and `scripts/mirror_tag.py`, which re-point `minds-v*` release tags onto the public mirror (`imbue-ai/mngr`). The mirror push exports commits only, so the mirror's newest `minds-v*` tag had been stuck at the copybara cutover (`minds-v0.3.8`) while the private repo moved on; `install-wsl.sh` (since folded into `apps/minds/scripts/install-linux.sh`) and any future Linux installer clone the public repo at the latest `minds-v*` tag, so they were pinned to a two-month-old release. The workflow runs on every `minds-v*` tag push, maps the private SHA to its public counterpart through the `GitOrigin-RevId` trailer (via the `main` first-parent commit that carries the tag -- the tagged commit itself, or the `--no-ff` merge that landed the release branch -- walking `main`'s first-parent history past private-only commits, and waiting for the mirror push to export the tagged commit first), and pushes the annotated tag with the sync App credential. Manual dispatch re-points one tag (`--force` to move an existing one) or, with an empty tag input, backfills every `minds-v*` tag the mirror lacks; tags not reachable from `main` (test tags) are reported and skipped.
